rationale: The full bounded policy failed the frozen anchor and every challenge-type replacement gate. It reduced weighted anchor closure by 33.3 percentage points, while only 11.1% of follow-up queries produced a declared gain and 88.9% occurred after the final gain. Independent blinded adjudication and equal-weight sensitivity preserved the decision.
reversal_condition: Reconsider a materially different adaptive control when matched repeated evidence clears the frozen closure, unsupported-claim, precision, unnecessary-query, bounds, failure-rate, and anchor non-inferiority gates. Retuning this failed policy without a new frozen comparison is insufficient.
